title: Mean of a normalized sign summand
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a coordinate $i<n$, let $x$ be uniformly distributed among all sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$. The mean of the coordinate value $x_i$ multiplied by $1/\sqrt n$ is zero.
